title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 job result of a commit_mode "launcher" job, <JOB_SCRATCH>/result.json (cockpit ruling E7: a Codex builder)
description: What a Codex builder reports when it ends. It has no write access to any git directory and no network, so it does not commit, push or open a pull request: it leaves its changes in the item's working copy and proposes a commit message here. There is therefore no branch, head_sha or pr_number from the job — any of them refuses the document. The supervisor (kyboot.py) never commits or pushes either: for a valid result with status 'done' and unchanged guards it records awaiting_launcher_commit true in state.json, and the launcher — outside the sandbox — checks the guards, stages, commits with commit_message (passed by file, never through a shell), pushes the item branch, opens or updates the pull request and writes head_sha and pr_number into the job record. Shape only; job_id and item are compared with the launching job by the supervisor. status 'done' is the job's own claim, never acceptance.

commit_message.description: The commit message the job proposes for its changes; null only when there is nothing to commit (blocked or failed).
